coordination.label: OCHA + UNHCR
coordination.ocha_plan: Sudan Humanitarian Needs and Response Plan 2026 (HNRP)
coordination.unhcr_plan: Sudan Country Refugee Response Plan (CRP) 2026 (UNHCR portal; lead inferred from hosting). Sudan is not one of the seven asylum countries in the Sudan Regional RRP.
coordination.note: HNRP (OCHA); a Sudan Country Refugee Response Plan 2026 is published on UNHCR's portal and cited in HNRP part 4; refugee needs also appear inside the HNRP.

cwg_reliefweb.page_title: Sudan Cash Working Group: Coordination Structure
cwg_reliefweb.last_update_basis: No CWG page found on response.reliefweb.int (fetch failed); the ReliefWeb report has blank posted/published fields and no date.
cwg_reliefweb.contacts_basis: Single undated CWG Information Management Officer vacancy that names the Cash Consortium of Sudan as programmatic co-chair alongside OCHA; not confirmed on a CWG page.
cwg_reliefweb.note: Page and contacts tab read by script on 6 Nov 2026; chairs taken from the contacts tab. A May 2024 sectoral cash snapshot exists; the MPCA and sectoral cash Power BI dashboard shows no update date.

cva_delivered_usd.note: OCHA Eastern Africa Q1 2025 overview gives about US$50.0M CVA disbursed in Sudan for the quarter; Q2 2025 overview says Sudan had the highest disbursements in the region but gives no dollar figure.

mpc_delivered_usd.note: HNRP 2026 states a plan to reach 1M with MPCA ($121.3M requirement) but no delivered MPCA amount; none found elsewhere.

sectoral_cva_delivered_usd.note: May 2024 sectoral snapshot reports 208,000 people reached (FSL 188,000; Protection 11,800; SNFI 8,300) but no US$ value; nothing more recent found.

fsps.name: Bankak (Bank of Khartoum app)
fsps.evidence: CGAP (Dec 2024) says Bankak handled over 50M transactions since the war began; CALP landscape review (2026) lists Bankak, cash-in-hand and mobile money as delivery mechanisms. No agency named as user.

fsps.name: MTN Sudan Fintech (MTN mobile money)
fsps.evidence: Mercy Corps BRIDGE pilot case study (Nov 2023): 25 displaced families in Gedaref received SDG 45,800 via USSD MTN mobile money.

fsps.name: Cashi
fsps.evidence: CALP article names RedRose and Cashi as FSPs for a locally led cash response; Cashi merchant network handled cash collection.

fsps.name: RedRose
fsps.evidence: Named alongside Cashi as FSP in the same CALP article (undated).

fsps.name: Hawala networks and traders
fsps.evidence: CGAP (Dec 2024): hawala networks and traders provide remittances and credit and are also helping deliver humanitarian cash; no agency named.
